description: Public-safe ledger for expected BTC Helper archive dates where no public read was published. New gaps on or after effective_date must have an explicit reason_code.

allowed_reason_codes.source_failure: A source-health failure prevented a publishable read.
allowed_reason_codes.model_validation_failure: The run was held because validation checks did not pass.
allowed_reason_codes.scheduled_maintenance: Publishing was intentionally paused for planned maintenance.
allowed_reason_codes.publication_failure: A read may have run, but publication failed or could not be verified.
allowed_reason_codes.operator_unavailable: Publishing was skipped because operator review/availability was not in place.
allowed_reason_codes.intentionally_withheld: The read was intentionally not published.
allowed_reason_codes.unknown: A current gap exists but the cause is not yet known; follow-up is required.
allowed_reason_codes.unknown_legacy_gap: A pre-ledger gap where the original cause was not preserved.
